summary: Sourcey documentation site for the gofiber/fiber Go package (github.com/gofiber/fiber/v3), generated from the pinned source commit 0d4d872a29e844159a59b0b9f4cd7afab6ec624a (26 Nov 2026, MIT). Built with Sourcey 3.9.5 using the godoc adapter in snapshot mode: a godoc.json snapshot of the root package (811 public API symbols) plus an overview, a quickstart, and five guides condensed from the project's own README at the pinned commit. The static site (10 pages) is staged for the docs PR to gofiber/docs and will publish at https://docs.gofiber.io/sourcey/ after merge; the deploy pipeline (deploy.yaml + docusaurus.config.ts url + live manifest.json 200) is verified, but the URL is NOT live yet.
